=== [[Sol 2009]]: Who are we? ===

: ''<big>Ray of summer sun,</big>''<br/>
: ''<big>Inseparable from Sol,</big>''<br/>
: ''<big>Know yourself and thrive.</big>''<br/>

: '''Who are we as Life?'''<br/>
: '''Who are we as individuals on a spiritual journey?'''<br/>
: '''Who are we as members and friends of the SolSeed Movement?'''<br/>

Join us the weekend of June 27th 2009 at Cape Lookout State Park on the Pacific coast of Oregon as these "questions of being" shape our community and practice. 

At this family friendly weekend there will be camping, hotdogs, marshmallows, philosophizing, songs around the campfire, sand-castles, and the development of a core action plan for how we can "Bring Life" together.

=== Where ===
Cape Lookout State Park near Tillamook Oregon

=== When ===
9AM Saturday June 27 to 1PM Monday June 29

You're welcome to arrive as early as Thursday night (after 4pm).  Meals will be provided Friday supper through Monday breakfast.

=== Cost ===
tbd

=== Signup ===
Things you'll need: tent, sleeping bag & pad, rain gear, and warm clothes.  We can help provide gear, email sol2009.b@thesanders.us
